**Strategic Sourcing Manager to drive Category Management at RTX A/S

**_Would you like to help shape the future of Strategic Sourcing in a global technology company? At RTX, we are strengthening our Category Management approach and are looking for a Strategic Sourcing Manager who can combine analytical insight, commercial judgement and technical curiosity to create measurable value across our supply base.

_**About RTX

**RTX is a global technology company that designs, develops and manufactures advanced wireless communication solutions for customers within Enterprise, Healthcare and Professional Audio.

Headquartered in Nørresundby, Denmark, RTX employs more than 300 people across Denmark, Hong Kong, Romania and the US. We work closely with global technology brands, delivering customized solutions from concept and development through production and full product lifecycle management.

Our combination of deep technical expertise, global partnerships and in-house development capabilities enables us to turn complex wireless technologies into reliable solutions that create value for our customers and their end users.

**What We Offer

**Strategic Sourcing at RTX is entering a new phase. We are moving from a more project-oriented sourcing setup to a structured Category Management approach, and you will play an important role in that development.

You will join a small and experienced Global Sourcing team with significant influence on priorities, methods and sourcing strategies. Working closely with Engineering, R&D and Operations, you will have the opportunity to shape how RTX works with categories, suppliers, cost optimization and supply resilience going forward.

You will report to the Director, Global Sourcing and be based at our headquarters in Nørresundby.

**Your Responsibilities

**You will be responsible for selected sourcing categories and develop strategies based on spend analysis, market insight, supplier performance and business requirements. A central part of the role is to identify opportunities across products and projects and translate them into sourcing initiatives that improve cost, competitiveness and supply security.

You will work closely with technical stakeholders when evaluating components, alternative solutions and second-source opportunities, while also strengthening RTX’s commercial position towards suppliers and EMS partners. Your key responsibilities include:

• Develop and implement category strategies based on spending, market and supplier analysis.

• Identify and execute cost reduction opportunities through bundling, standardization and supplier consolidation.

• Develop second-source and dual-source solutions to reduce supply risk.

• Work with Engineering and R&D on alternative components and technical specifications.

• Build market and supplier intelligence to support sourcing decisions and negotiations.

• Negotiate strategic prices, contracts and commercial terms.

• Strengthening collaboration with EMS partners and contribute to the development of a more focused partner setup.

• Support initiatives that improve long-term delivery performance and supply resilience.

**Your Qualifications

**We are looking for a sourcing professional with strong analytical capabilities, commercial understanding and an interest in technology.

You may already have solid experience within Category Management and Strategic Sourcing, or you may come from an electronics or manufacturing environment where you have worked strategically with suppliers and components. The exact combination is less important than your ability to understand the business, challenge existing solutions and drive initiatives over time. We expect you to:

• Have experience in Strategic Sourcing, Category Management, procurement or supplier management.

• Be confident working with spend analysis, market data and sourcing strategies.

• Have experience from a manufacturing or technology-driven environment, preferably involving electronics, components or EMS partners.

• Understand the interaction between sourcing, Engineering and R&D.

• Have strong negotiation skills and experience with contracts, suppliers and cost optimization.

• Be analytical, structured and able to turn complex information into clear recommendations.

• Be persistent and comfortable driving initiatives that require alignment across several stakeholders.

• Communicate professionally in English and Danish in an international environment.

A relevant degree within Supply Chain Management, Business, Engineering or a related field is an advantage, but practical experience, mindset and your ability to create results are equally important.

**Application and Contact Information

**Guldbrandsen & Lythje is handling the recruitment process. If you have any questions regarding the position, you are welcome to contact Partner Dan Lythje at +45 93 84 84 49 or Partner Lise Guldbrandsen at +45 20 67 67 57. Applications should be sent to: Strategic Sourcing Manager to drive Category Management at RTX A/S - Guldbrandsen & Lythje ApS

We invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis. You can apply for the position via the link to the right of the advertisement.

_Do you want to work at the forefront of SEO & GEO for some of the largest companies in Denmark and beyond? Are you looking for a role where you can take real ownership of a diverse client portfolio and deliver measurable commercial results?

_If you answered yes, then you might be our next SEO Specialist.

**Drive organic growth for clients

**As our SEO Specialist, you will manage your own client portfolio, translate organic search data into actionable strategies, and ensure high-quality execution that provides real value for our clients.

**Responsibilities

**To give you a clear picture of where you’ll spend your time, the role is built around these core responsibilities:

• Strategy & execution: Develop and implement comprehensive on-page, off-page, and technical SEO strategies tailored to the business goals of our clients.

• Drive performance for top-tier brands: Serve as the day-to-day driver for a diverse portfolio of clients, ranging from e-commerce platforms to established B2B brands.

• Modern search navigation: Adapt strategies to account for the changing search landscape, including AI overviews, LLMs, and evolving user search behaviors.

• Cross-discipline collaboration: Work closely with internal teams within Content, CRO, and UX to deliver holistic, high-impact digital experiences.

• Innovation & tooling: Utilise and contribute to our advanced tool stack, leveraging automated workflows, AI, templates, and Python scripts to deliver deep, efficient technical audits.

**Join our SEO team

**You’ll join a team of 40+ specialists and senior specialists who genuinely care about doing great work together. We collaborate a lot across different markets and teams, and we always keep things open and transparent. For us, a great culture means giving honest feedback, sharing our ambitions, and backing each other up so we can all keep growing.

**Bring knowledge and strong SEO drive

**We are looking for someone who can bring proven SEO experience and a desire to continuously improve in a field that is moving fast. You are comfortable taking ownership, working in a structured way, and turning complex input into practical action.

**You Will Likely Recognise Yourself In The Following Qualifications

**

• 2+ years of experience: You have hands-on experience with technical and strategic SEO, ideally from an agency or a fast-paced in-house environment.

• Tool mastery: You are familiar with tools such as Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, Google Search Console, and Google Analytics 4.

• Technical bridge-builder: You have a basic understanding of DevTools and web architecture to troubleshoot technical issues and effectively communicate with client developers.

• Data translator: You bring a data-driven approach with the ability to turn complex data sets into clear, actionable recommendations.

• An impactful communicator: You are proficient in English and Danish, with the ability to explain technical SEO concepts clearly to both marketing teams and business stakeholders.

• A hungry and curious mindset: The changing digital landscape energizes you, and you see change as an opportunity to expand your expertise. You are also the first in line when testing the latest AI tools and new trends.

**What it’s like working at s360

**At s360, you will be part of a Marketing and AI consultancy, working alongside more than 330 skilled colleagues across 10 offices in 8 countries. While our shared mission is to help brands and retailers grow, we are equally committed to fostering a strong culture, defined by collaboration, drive, and continuous development. We believe that our culture and ways of working are key to delivering long-term, meaningful results.

As a part of our team, you can look forward to:

• Skilled colleagues: Collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry and be part of an ambitious team with deep expertise across all key digital disciplines.

• Top-tier clients: Work with some of the biggest brands in the world on solving their most complex and interesting commercial problems.

• Growth journey: Join one of the fastest-growing marketing and AI consultancies in Europe with the ambition of becoming the best in the world.

• International environment: With 10 offices across 8 countries, you will have the opportunity to collaborate with people from diverse cultures around the world.

• Career acceleration: Get individual career plans to influence your own professional path and contribute to shaping the company’s future.

• Continuous development: A learning culture where people strive to become 1% better every day, supported by advanced training and knowledge sharing.

**We’d love to hear from you

**Does this sound like the right fit for you? Do you have any questions? Then don’t hesitate to apply or reach out to Group Lead, SEO, Nikolaj Mogensen at nm@s360digital.com or by phone: +45 31522022.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and hire as soon as the right candidate is found, so please send your CV and application as soon as possible. All inquiries are treated confidentially.

Please note: Due to the summer holiday season, you can expect feedback regarding your application in early August.

jobs.occupation: Student assistant - ideation and early innovation in R&D at Coloplast
jobs.description:
Curious about how problems, user needs, and ideas turn into real solutions? Interested in hands-on experience with innovation in a global MedTech company – and helping shape what we work on next? Then this is your chance to join our R&D Scoping team as a student assistant.

We are strengthening our innovation funnel to ensure a focused, high-quality, and strategically aligned pipeline. As part of this, you will support idea management – helping capture, structure, and move forward the right ideas at the right time.

About the R&D Scoping team

We are an early-stage R&D team dedicated to exploring, shaping, and testing the future of Coloplast.

We work with ideas, concepts, and new solution spaces – turning them into structured opportunities for product development. Our team brings together backgrounds in design, strategy, business, and engineering – a mix of thinkers, doers, and prototype builders.

As our student assistant, you will:

•   Gain hands-on insight into how early-stage innovation works in practice

•   Help turn ideas into tangible concepts

•   Co-manage our ideation platform

•   Support rapid testing and learning

Your daily responsibilities:

You will help ensure that ideas flow smoothly through the innovation process and support the day-to-day work in the Scoping team. This includes:

•   Maintaining our ideation platform (NOSCO) – setting up and managing idea channels, campaigns, and scoping flows

•   Supporting colleagues in using the platform – onboarding, guidance, and troubleshooting

•   Helping plan and run idea campaigns end-to-end – from mobilization and ideation to screening, development, and pitching

•   Contributing to continuous improvement – refining processes, templates, and ways of working

•   Supporting the team broadly with research, analysis, coordination, and ad hoc tasks across projects

Expected qualifications

•   Currently studying within a relevant field (e.g. business, innovation, engineering, or similar)

•   Well-structured with the ability to handle multiple tasks and collaborate with different stakeholders

•   Comfortable working with digital tools and platforms; experience with ideation management or innovation collaboration tools is a plus

•   Interest in innovation, idea development processes, and early-stage product work

•   Strong communication skills and a helpful, service-oriented mindset

Language skills:

•   Fluent written and spoken English

•   Danish is not required

Practical information:

The position is based on-site at Coloplast HQ in Humlebæk, North Zealand, Denmark.

Expected workload is approximately 15–20 hours per week, with flexibility around exams.

Interested?

We are looking to welcome our new colleague as soon as possible and will conduct interviews on an ongoing basis.

Pursuing an ambitious growth agenda, Coloplast develops and markets products and services that make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs. Employing about 16.000 people and with products available in more than 143 countries, we are one of the world´s leading medical device companies. We are constantly growing our business and always looking for new ways to move forward – we explore, learn and look for new ways of doing things.

Coloplast is committed to being an inclusive organization, where people bring their differences to work each day, fulfil their potential and have a strong sense of belonging because – and not despite – of their differences. We therefore encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, age, race, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religious belief or physical ability.

Visit us on Coloplast.com.

Watch the film. Follow us on LinkedIn.

Solvexis Consult is looking for experienced Electrical Holdledere for work at an Energinet facility in Denmark.

You will lead and supervise electrical work in an assigned area, either within the control building or in outdoor high-voltage areas. Where work takes place concurrently in separate areas, multiple Holdledere may be required.

Candidates must meet Energinet’s training, competence and approval requirements before undertaking the role.

Responsibilities

• 
Lead and supervise the electrical work team at the assigned worksite.

• 
Ensure work follows approved instructions, risk assessments and Energinet safety requirements.

• 
Brief the work team and confirm that responsibilities, hazards and safety measures are understood.

• 
Coordinate with the Arbejdsleder, Koblingsleder, Energinet representatives and contractors.

• 
Confirm that required clearances and electrical safety measures are in place before work begins.

• 
Stop work if conditions change or safety requirements cannot be maintained.

• 
Ensure safe completion and handback of the worksite.

• 
Report deviations, unsafe conditions and incidents.

Qualifications

We expect that you have:

• 
A relevant qualification, such as utility operator, electrician, electrical installer, marine engineer, electrical power engineer or similar.

• 
Experience with high-voltage installations, substations or comparable electrical infrastructure.

• 
Previous experience as a Holdleder, Arbejdsleder or electrical supervisor.

• 
Knowledge of BEK nr. 1608 and DS/EN 50110-1.

• 
Experience with electrical isolation, LOTO, earthing and safe working procedures.

• 
Sufficient Danish to complete Energinet’s mandatory Danish-language Work Supervisor/Team Leader course.

• 
Professional working proficiency in English.

• 
The qualifications and documented practical training required under Energinet’s NDI-020, including the applicable supervised training period.

Previous Energinet training or approval as Holdleder will be a significant advantage.

What we offer

Solvexis provides structured onboarding, administrative support and regular follow-up throughout the assignment.

Employment terms will be agreed based on your qualifications, experience and the conditions of the assignment.

Application

Please apply through our recruitment portal and upload your CV in English.

Your CV should clearly document your:

• 
Electrical qualifications.

• 
High-voltage and substation experience.

• 
Previous Holdleder or supervisory roles.

• 
Energinet training, approvals and supervised practical training.

Applications will be reviewed continuously.

Do you want to gain experience working in the intersection between product engineering, product support and communication of product applications? Are you interested in working with modern technologies across hardware, connectivity, and software? Are you looking to start your career in an innovative green tech company where you can make a real impact?

Here is what the job entails

As our Intern in Technical Product Management, you will support our product managers in product lifecycle management. You will be working hands-on with the development of new products as well as gaining experience in documentation and customer support.

More specifically you will be:

• Maintaining and supporting product hardware and connectivity

• Managing the product lifecycle from launch to optimization and maintenance

• Delivering technical support and analysis of technical issues

• Creating and maintaining technical documentation

In this role, you will work end-to-end with product development while gaining experience in technical product management. You will have the opportunity to take ownership of your own projects based on your interests and career goals, working closely with experienced colleagues who will support your development throughout the internship.

Meet your future team

With a direct reference to the Senior Manager in Technical Product Management, you will become a part of our Technical Product Management-team in the Water department consisting of 10 passionate and skilled colleagues. Together, we combine technical expertise with cross-organizational collaboration to ensure our meters, communication infrastructure, and software meet market demands and quality standards while balancing technical demands with commercial goals. In the team we foster a supportive and collaborative environment where knowledge sharing and sparring are highly encouraged.

Did you know? Collaboration is the backbone of our culture - but it is cake and coffee that fuels our journey to success!

Less about us, more about you

We are looking for a curious student who is motivated to operate at the intersection of product technology, customer needs, and the creation of business value. You approach your work with a proactive and structured mindset, while maintaining a strong focus on quality.

In order to succeed, we imagine that you:

• Are currently studying a degree in Global Business Engineering, Business Development Engineering, or another related field with focus on engineering/digitalization

• Like challenging the status quo and bring new ideas to the table

• Thrive in a collaborative environment interacting with colleagues across the organization

As we are an international organization it is important that you are fluent in English.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, this is an internship position, and we value curiosity and a willingness to learn just as much as experience. If the role interests you and you are motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply.

We offer more than just an internship

At Kamstrup, your contribution as an intern is highly valued, and we cherish the good colleagueship. Therefore, you will experience an internship with a strong focus on your individual development through challenging tasks, career sparring, voluntary courses, as well as social events and a large network. We are proud, that our internship program has resulted in Studenterhus Aarhus granting us with the Mentor Award, the Internationalization Award, the Jury’s Special Award and the award for East Jutland’s Best Internship.

Besides the best colleagues you could imagine, we also offer:

• The internship is paid if your place of study allows it

• Multiple internship events and weekly internship lunches

• Employee benefits including a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in-house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic

• An active employee association, that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community

Do you want to be a part of Kamstrup?

The applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, but you can expect a response within six weeks. Details about the internship will be agreed upon individually. However, the internship is expected to run from the beginning of February 2027 until the end of June 2027.

Kamstrup Head Quarter is in Stilling south of Aarhus, and bus number 200 takes you right to the door.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Senior Manager, Technical Product Management - Water, Kirsten Sahl, on telephone nr.: +45 89 93 10 00.

About Octarine Bio

Octarine Bio is a Copenhagen-based company pioneering a new generation of sustainable, bio-based colourants. We engineer nature-inspired colours that deliver the performance, stability, and safety profile required for demanding industrial applications while decoupling colour from fossil-based chemistry. PurePalette™ is supplied as a formulated product, ready to use in textiles, plastics, paper, and more.

Designed for drop-in integration and targeting price parity with conventional colourants, PurePalette™ lets customers adopt a more sustainable solution without compromising cost, quality, or scalability.

The Role

As a Technical Sales Manager, you will own the commercial relationships that take PurePalette™ from sample to qualified supply. You will identify and develop new customers across multiple regions and application segments. You will guide customers through the full sales process, from the technical evaluation that industrial colourants require — sampling, trials, and qualification on their own equipment — to supply agreement execution.

This is a hands-on role in a company at an early commercial stage. You will work closely with technical and commercial teams to understand customer needs and bring learnings in the field into product selection and development. As volumes grow, you will also help build the order fulfilment and logistics processes that reliable supply depends on.

We are looking for someone who is comfortable holding technical conversations with engineers and commercial conversations with purchasing managers, and who is motivated by building something new.

Key Responsibilities

• Identify, qualify, and develop new customers & key accounts across target markets and regions

• Manage sample and trial programmes from first request through to qualification on customer equipment

• Present PurePalette™ to technical and commercial audiences, from process engineers to purchasing and sustainability teams

• Understand customer applications and requirements, and work with R&D and application scientists to match them to the right formulation

• Prepare quotations and proposals, and negotiate supply agreements

• Build and maintain relationships with customers, distributors, and partners

• Maintain accurate opportunity and account information in the CRM

• Represent Octarine Bio at trade shows and industry events, and feed market and competitor intelligence back to the business

• Deliver on revenue and growth targets, and help shape our commercial strategy

Qualifications & Experience

Required

• 5+ years in technical sales, business development, or application support in an industrial B2B setting

• Strong ability to deliver a technical sales presentation, to hold a credible technical conversation and to translate it into a commercial one

• Willingness to travel for customer visits and trade shows

• Professional fluency in English; additional languages are an advantage

• Curious, proactive, well organized, and comfortable owning a sales pipeline

Preferred

• Experience in colourants, pigments, dyes, inks, coatings, or textile chemicals

• Familiarity with how industrial customers qualify a new raw material — sampling, trials, and regulatory or restricted substance screening

• Experience selling a novel or sustainability-positioned product into cost-sensitive markets

• Working knowledge of the operational side of sales, e.g., order fulfillment, warehousing, shipping, and export documentation

Why work with us

Octarine Bio is located in central Copenhagen – one of Europe’s most liveable cities – in a country world-renowned for its exceptional quality of life and work-life balance. As a biosolutions scale-up, our team members have a high degree of autonomy, and their decisions and daily work have a direct, measurable impact on the company’s success. We offer a competitive salary and an international, collaborative working environment.

How to apply

Please submit to stephanie@octarinebio.com your CV along with a short cover letter explaining your relevant technical and commercial experience and why you would like to join Octarine Bio.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply early.

That means a big part of your day-to-day will be outbound prospecting, and getting meetings on the calendar, as well as taking meetings booked by SDRs. If you thrive in fast-paced environments, love building relationships, earning commission and get energy from creating opportunities where none existed before, we want to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities:

• 
Own the full sales cycle from first outreach to close, and then account growth

• 
Build and manage your pipeline from scratch through cold calling, outbound outreach, and consistent follow-up, working closely with SDRs where relevant to close new opportunities

•

Track pipeline and account activity, gather feedback, and ensure retention through strong service and communication

What We’re Looking For:

• 
3+ years of experience in sales, account management, or client success, preferably in knowledge services, professional services, or within pharma/life sciences

• 
A builder mindset. You like starting from zero, creating momentum, and owning your number

• 
Comfortable doing outbound every day, including cold calling, and staying consistent even when it takes time to break through

• 
Strategic thinker with a client-first mindset and a drive to grow business relationships

• 
Extremely organized and detail-oriented. You keep things moving, nothing slips through the cracks, and your inbox is always under control

• 
Highly responsive and proactive. You don’t wait to be asked, and you never leave a client waiting

• 
A strong communicator, both written and verbal, comfortable engaging with clients across different time zones, cultures, and seniority levels

Why Join KGG?

• 
Accelerated career growth. This is a high-visibility role with direct impact. You won’t be stepping into an existing playbook. You’ll help build the pipeline and get real credit for the results

• 
A dynamic and engaging environment with a diverse international team

• 
Opportunity to make your mark in a fast-evolving company at the forefront of decentralized science

• 
Competitive compensation and performance-based incentives

• 
Flexible work environment and support for professional development

**Summary

**At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming phenomenal products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. The Creativity Apps team needs your help shaping the next generation of creative editing tools by working on state-of-the-art technologies to surprise and delight creative pros and enthusiasts alike. You’ll be working with the world-class teams behind Final Cut Pro, Logic Pro, iMovie, and GarageBand to create next-generation tools for creators!

**Description

**We're looking for a Performance Tooling Engineer to own the tooling and automated tests that keep our products fast, efficient, and correct. Your mission is to catch regressions before they ship, across latency, memory, power/thermals and functionality, by building the test harnesses, benchmarks, and CI infrastructure that make regressions visible, reproducible, and actionable.

The systems you build will run continuously across our device fleet and become the safety net our engineering team relies on. If you enjoy turning "it feels slower" into a hard number on a dashboard with a bisected culprit commit, this is for you.

**Responsibilities

**

• Design, write, and maintain automated tests that detect performance regressions (latency, memory footprint, power consumption, etc.) and functional regressions.

• Build and operate CI pipelines and tooling that run these tests reliably across a fleet of hardware devices.

• Create dashboards, alerting, and triage tooling that surface regressions early and help engineers root-cause them quickly, e.g. automated bisection, historical trend tracking.

• Partner with cross-functional teams & leadership to define meaningful performance goals and acceptance criteria.

• Continuously improve test coverage, execution speed, flakiness, and the developer experience of running and interpreting tests.

**Minimum Qualifications

**

• Very strong problem-solving and coding skills.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Experience building and maintaining CI systems.

• Solid understanding of performance measurement fundamentals: how to benchmark reliably, control for noise, and reason about latency, memory, and power/thermal metrics.

• Experience writing automated tests and the tooling/frameworks around them.

• Proven track record of integrating AI tools to enhance both personal productivity and team workflows.

**Preferred Qualifications

**

• Experience developing for Apple platforms (iOS/macOS), with working knowledge of Swift.

• Familiarity with the Apple development toolchain: Xcode, Instruments, and related profiling and testing.

• Experience with GPU programming and image processing systems (Metal, OpenCL, CUDA or similar).

• Experience with regression testing across many hardware devices, e.g., device labs, device farms, or fleet-based test automation.

At Apple, we believe accessibility is a fundamental human right. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. By welcoming as many perspectives as possible, we help you build a career where you feel like you belong.

Learn about accessibility in Apple’s workplace

Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programmes as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.

Our capabilities include programme, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.

We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier programme, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.

**Job Description

**

We are looking for an OFCI (Owner Furnished Contractor Installed) Project Manager, responsible for ensuring that all activities in regard to the owner furnished equipment (that is purchased by the client), are executed in a qualitative and timely manner. A key role within the organization, you will be the client’s representative overseeing the entirety of the OFE (Owner Furnished Equipment) / FIA (Field Integrated Assembly) activities, working with different stakeholders (client sourcing departments and contractors on the project) and updating the project team on advancements and potential bottlenecks.

• Managing OFE; monitoring and reporting on vendor and integrator off site activities, ensuring alignment with project objectives and client strategies.

• Performing in depth contract and scope of work reviews with gap analysis, ensuring all contractual scope is covered between the vendors and site contractors teams.

• Collaborate closely with stakeholders across various client departments and contractors to gather requirements, manage expectations, and address concerns proactively.

• Provide regular (weekly) progress updates to stakeholders, ensuring transparent communication and fostering trust throughout the project lifecycle.

• Manage OFE schedules, tracking milestones and timelines to guide project execution effectively. Ensuring ROS (required on site) dates correlate between schedule and vendors.

• Swiftly resolve issues, blockers and conflicts that may arise during project execution, demonstrating strong problem-solving abilities and a communicative supporting work ethic.

• Structure the complex work interfaces with ease and simplicity showing effective ways of working and managing activities and stakeholders across the critical PM categories of: Scope, Time, Cost and Quality.

This role will require a large degree of on-site presence, with some flexibility to be agreed upon.

**Qualifications

**

• Minimum of 3 years in Supply chain coordinator (or OFCI) and / or Project Management capacity working on complex, large scale projects. Data Center Industry experience is preferred.

• Experience in Construction / Engineering, preferably Mechanical & Electrical, or equivalent industry experience.

• Ability to manage multiple vendors and coordinate across teams.

• Excellent negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Superb communication skills in English – with Danish as a nice to have.

• Proactive, efficient, and problem-solving PM mentality.

• Strong knowledge of supply chain processes, customs regulations, and construction logistics for critical Data Center equipment (or similar industrial equipment).

• Proficiency in EDMS systems (ACC is preferred) and project management tools.

**

**

• Exciting work in an international environment.
